entities.name: Bulat Zhumadilov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bolat Zhumadilov is a Kazakh boxer who competed in the Men's Flyweight at the 1996 and 2000 Summer Olympics and won silver medals on both occasions. He won the world title at the 1999 World Amateur Boxing Championships in Houston, Texas, United States.
